reading.body:
This NY2 facility in Secaucus is one of ten buildings Equinix operates across the New York metro, and the company publishes no power capacity figure for this site. At 131,040 square feet with N+1 redundancy for both power and cooling, the building is sized for mission-critical colocation, but its IT load capacity cannot be determined from available specifications.

Equinix describes NY3 (also in Secaucus) as the metro's largest site serving major financial, media, and enterprise companies. NY2's role within the Secaucus campus and relative capacity compared to the rest of the metro network is not published. This facility ranks sixth among New Jersey data centers by disclosed power capacity, but five facilities statewide publish their megawatts and 48 have been mapped, so most remain undisclosed.

Without a published power figure, this site's relevance to AI scaling cannot be assessed from operator specifications alone. New York metro capacity is spread across at least ten Equinix buildings, and only five of any facilities in New Jersey have disclosed their power capacity to the public record.
